comment: Ratchet for issue #327 (python scripts/check_test_signal.py). 'no_signal' is the debt: tests with nothing that can fail them, by node id. It only shrinks - run --fix after strengthening or removing a test. 'smoke' maps the node id of every @pytest.mark.smoke test to the reason it has no assertion. 'metrics' is the reference the PR report compares against.
